decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming and lab-material range, had their own page through 2019, and give no sign of falling short, so a large firm with slack has little reason to drop them.

PETG thermoforming blanks are a core material for aligners and splints in dental labs, had steady dedicated presentation, and match the firm's digital-workflow direction, so results likely meet aspiration.

The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests modest importance, but as a cheap complementary consumable for custom earmolds and devices it costs little to carry and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

Custom hearing protection earmolds use the firm's skilled custom-device manufacturing and serve its hearing-care channel, and they stayed listed while the weaker earmold line and contrast spray were dropped, which implies satisfactory performance.
